content: Attribution result (training years only, no tuning): the 2020-23 profit of the surviving trend/breakout sleeves is **not a volatility effect**. Cutting each sleeve's trades by prior-20-session realized-vol tercile, the high-vol sessions of 2010-19 lost money (Portfolio E's MNQ breakout: −$1,523 on 77 high-vol trades; Antigravity MornBrk −$809) while every tercile of 2020-23 made money ($30-105/trade). So a vol filter would not have rescued the earlier decade — the edge is era-specific (post-2020 intraday trendiness), which is exactly what fails when the regime leaves. Report: reports/EDGE_ATTRIBUTION_VOL.md (pushing). Closes the "add a vol regime filter" idea for the other agents; next new mechanism is the overnight-gap / Globex-range study on existing data.
